verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs explicitly define incremental sync as pulling 'only the data that has changed since the previous sync' and describe CDC log-based state tracking (reading logs while keeping track of current position) plus configurable sync modes that combine source/destination behavior — this is core, well-documented cursor/state management, not manual full reloads. Community evidence corroborates real-world incremental use ('Airbyte is a godsend for us... it continued to sync happily' after initial setup), though one user needed a workaround to bootstrap an 8-billion-row table's first sync, indicating some friction at extreme scale. Missing for 10: independent benchmark/quality verification of cursor accuracy across all connector types and more detail on state-store recovery edge cases.
